label: unrun
scenario: W01 Review stage for Reply Assist at Larkspur Support. opportunity-comparison.md v1 recommends draft assistance over doing nothing and a template library, with all three rows on the same criteria. Claim C2 (agents retype the same three answers daily) cites one ws-alpha ticket; claim C3 (drafting saves ten minutes per ticket) has no source. The review must return a verdict, decision-changing gaps and specialist assignments.

checks: Every claim the recommendation depends on (C1, C2, C3) appears in findings with a support value and a consequence_if_false.
comparison_check records explicit values for do_nothing_row, non_ai_row, same_criteria and recommendation_follows.
Each gap names the decision it changes and a resolving task; none reads as generic advice to do more research.
Each proposed assignment names a role, input versions, expected output, dependencies and a budget mode.
The review states that it is a manager review, not an independent audit and not test execution, and observed_checks is empty.
Any option that sends replies is listed under requires_other_authority with human-owner as the authority.
